race.comment: BRAVE SUMMIT (5) was a brave fourth on debut when beaten by less than a length, and then was too tough at Cootamundra last time out. This is not much harder, and she can go on with it. YOU SAID WHAT (6) was an overdue maiden winner at Donald last start, scoring by 1.5 lengths over 1350m. Honest mare with a good top-three strike rate and is worth including. CHAPADOS (10) has yet to hit her straps in two runs this time in work, the latest effort an eighth over 1247m at Geelong. Suited here and can feature. MISLIGHT (9) has been freshened up since racing on the speed and fading to finish sixth over 1547m at Geelong on August 28. Will find this a little easier than last time. Don't underestimate.
